title: Best Student Loan Refinance 2026: 5 lenders compared at $50K balance
description: SoFi, Earnest, Splash, Laurel Road, MEFA — same $50K balance, 720 FICO, $85K income. APRs, fees, perks for the same applicant.
lede: Five student loan refi lenders. Same applicant profile submitted to all five via soft-pull rate quotes.
methodology: $50K federal balance, 720 FICO, $85K income, 5-year employment, MA resident, BA from MA university. Rate quotes via soft credit pull only.

sections.heading: Rates and perks for the same applicant
paragraphs: Splash Financial: 5.10% (lowest, marketplace). Earnest: 5.24% + skip-a-payment. SoFi: 5.49% + career coaching. MEFA: 5.39% (MA only). Laurel Road: 5.65% (healthcare-specialized).
SoFi member perks (coaching, networking, lounge) are real value for 25-35 year olds. Splash wins on rate for general applicants. Laurel Road wins for medical residents with reduced payments.

faqs.q: Should I refinance federal student loans?
faqs.a: Only if rate drops by 1%+ AND you don't need federal protections (IDR, PSLF). Refinancing federal to private loses these forever. Consult a fee-only advisor first.
Fixed unless your refinance term is under 5 years AND variable starts >1% below fixed. 2022-2024 rate hikes burned variable-rate refinancers from 2020-2021.

sofi-student-loan-refi.review: Best member benefits. Career coaching and networking events are real value for early-career borrowers. Rate (5.49%) is mid-pack.

earnest-student-loan-refi.review: Most flexible terms. Custom 5-20 year length, skip-a-payment annually (rare).

splash-financial-refi.review: Marketplace model — 10+ backend lenders in one app. Won our test with 5.10% APR.

laurel-road-student-refi.review: Best for healthcare. Parent PLUS refi, resident-reduced payments. General rate 5.65% (highest).

mefa-student-loan-refi.review: MA nonprofit lender. No fees, fixed rates only. 5.39% is fair with transparent pricing.

pinDescription: 5 student loan refi lenders at $50K, 720 FICO. SoFi vs Earnest vs Splash vs Laurel Road vs MEFA. Same applicant, real quotes. #studentloans #refinance
